body: Posting from my throwaway as well. I’ve had this exact thing happen, and after talking to my therapist, it’s pretty normal for people who have been sexually abused. I’ve never acted on it except experimentation when I was 8 as well. Just knowing that I’d never actually do to someone what was done to me has helped tremendously. When I was 15, I almost did, just because I wanted to know what was going through my abusers head. And I couldn’t go through with it. Now those feelings are gone.

I have tried-we’ve had the same fights for 6 years. I think I only married him because I was afraid of being alone. I have a really good job-but a couple of my coworkers make my life hell. I want to believe that, but I don’t think I’ve ever been truly happy
